graders.name: cards built, fit, export, numbers traced
design suits the topic
graders.criteria: This HTML page holds a set of image cards summarizing a news article about a rebuilt cargo harbor. PASS if the visual design (the :root color tokens, fonts and the card-top strip) clearly borrows from the harbor or shipping world, for example nautical, port, container or tide-chart cues, and the page is not left on the template's placeholder blue-gray palette with {{...}} font names. FAIL otherwise.

graders.name: cards built, fit, export, numbers traced
reports the shortfalls too
graders.criteria: These cards summarize a library network's annual report. The report has a section on where it fell short: a branch roof repair ran late, the summer reading program missed its target, and a mobile library van did not arrive. PASS if at least one card mentions at least one of these shortfalls. FAIL if the cards only report good news.
